comparison: paired, single sealed pass, greedy temperature 0.0, all declared models scored on the same 12 tasks

quality_tolerance.basis: student minus teacher, measured in the same sealed pass
quality_tolerance.overall_rationale: one holdout task of twelve is worth 0.0833 mean reward; one task of slack, no more
quality_tolerance.per_band_rationale: each band holds four tasks; one task of slack per band
quality_tolerance.primary_band_rationale: the band the teacher's GRPO adapter was trained to lift (0.833 to 1.000 in the source arm)

guardrails.hard_fail_definition: reward == 0.0, which the evaluator returns for any forbidden write or effect

verdict_rule: PASS only if every quality_tolerance and guardrail condition holds; any single violation is a FAIL and is reported as a FAIL

efficiency_claim_rule.detail: latency, turn-count, and token deltas are reported but never used to override a quality FAIL; a latency or cost win is claimed only from warm-start measurements taken in the same pass, and cost.usd stays null while the provider billing endpoint returns no dollar amounts

grpo_polish.predeclared_rationale: every model, including the untuned student base, reached mean reward 1.000 on the full dev split; there is no measured dev-quality gap for GRPO to close, so the spend is not justified

notes: Predeclared and committed before the paired sealed holdout run. The holdout is executed exactly once, guarded by artifacts/holdout-lock.json.
